content:
[Intro]
[Bm/F#]
Hello
mire,
you
thick black
fight
Lay it
out,
set it
down

[Verse 1]
[G]Strike
me dead
[Bm/F#]
[G]if
I’m wrong
[Bm/F#]
[G]Let
me know
[Bm/F#]the cost
of ta-
[G]king my
own head
[Bm/F#]

[Chorus]
[Em]
Fire fly-
[F#m]ing I
can’t take
[D/F#]a break
to
[G]fight
[Em]
Fire floo-
[F#m]ding out
my taste
[D/F#]to know a
[G]lie

[Break]
[G]
[Bm/F#]
[G]
[Bm/F#]

[Verse 2]
[G]All’s
not lost,
[Bm/F#]
[G]if you call
it crossed
[Bm/F#]
[G]All
we are
[Bm/F#]is se-
cond lines
[G]that make
the first
[Bm]look straight

[Chorus]
[Em]
Fire fly-
[F#m]ing I
can’t take
[D/F#]a break
to
[G]fight
[Em]
Fire floo-
[F#m]ding out
my taste
[D/F#]to know
a
[G]lie
[Em]
Fire fly-
[F#m]ing I
can’t take
[D/F#]a break
to
[G]fight
[Em]
Fire floo-
[F#m]ding out
my taste
[D/F#]to know
what’s
[G]
right

[Interlude]
[Bm/F#]Father if you
hear me please
[D/F#]
[G]Take my breath and
bind my knees
[A/E]
Cause I’m
[Bm/F#]staring at the
tallest trees
[D/F#]
[G]Darker than the
night I fight
[A/E]
[Bm/F#]Louder than my
honest pleas
[D/F#]
[G]Drinking all I
have to bleed
[A/E]
[Bm/F#]Days they are
hungry things
[D/F#]
Su-
[G]rrender them to
find release
[A/E]

[Outro]
[Bm/F#]
[D/F#]
[G]
[A/E]
[Bm/F#]
[D/F#]
[G]

[Fade Out]
[A/E]
[Bm/F#]
title: Hello Mire
tuning: E A D G B E
